title: Scanner distilled-detection: blank-line tolerance is claimed in prose but only malformed-line tolerance is scenario-tested
why: The doctrine/scanner README's idempotent-distillation contract states the detection tolerates malformed AND blank ledger lines, but scanner.feature only freezes a malformed-line scenario; blank-line tolerance has no independent discriminator. Worth a dedicated blank-line scenario if the two code paths ever diverge.
